pages.text: $(bold)Dreadsteel$() (Armor-exclusive trait, Dreadsteel armor parts): Fear descends, and all creatures bow down.$(br2)Effect: While worn, grants Night Vision, Fire Resistance, immunity to frost, and a damage cap (≤ 30 damage per 0.5 seconds).$(br2)It stays active for as long as you wear it (and ends the moment you take it off).
